answer_1.quote: To create diverse questions, the first step of the process was to augment the seed data using GPT-4 Turbo and Claude 3.5 Sonnet to generate additional content on the Glianorex.

answer_2.quote: The task followed the MedQA 4-option format, using a log-likelihood approach to measure accuracy.

answer_4.quote: We recruited two physicians from our institution who completed at least one step of the USMLE in the past five years to assess the quality of the questions.
answer_4.guideline: They evaluated a random sample of 100 English questions on a 7-point Likert scale and answered them—without prior exposure to textbooks on the Glianorex—to establish an expert baseline.
